_about: Apple Support style, measured from 3 Apple Support videos at 1920x1080. Ryo's choices win where they conflict: captions centred under the device in Myriad Pro (Apple uses voice-over), gentle zoom factors.

layout._note: Apple's wide shots: MacBook ~89% / iPhone ~88% of frame height. Shrunk just enough for the caption band; title cap height ~5.3% (Apple 6.3%) so it fits under the device.

move._note: one curve for every zoom, device move, text slide and transition

zoom._note: fewer zooms with long holds; strokes is the key moment (1.4x, top of Ryo's range; Apple allows 1.5x)
